title: Updating the Next-Radius Coordinate
statement: For any machine state $st$ and natural number $k$, replacing coordinate $3$ of its 17-entry counter vector by $k$ gives the counter vector of the state obtained from $st$ by setting its next radius $s_1$ to $k$.
replaced:
For any state and any natural number $k$, replacing the fourth coordinate of its
$17$-component register vector by $k$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by
setting its next radius $s_1$ to $k$.
